reuse.why: Extends the existing applyWeekendRule, which every date path already calls with its whole recur config, so holidays reach all sites without touching them.

duplication.why: The non-working-day test (isNonWorkingDay), the stepping loop and the window size (getShiftWindowDays) each exist once.

placement.why: All rule logic stays in shared/schedules.ts, which owns weekend solving; the server only consumes the exported window helper.

scope.why: Type field, shared rule, parseRecurDate passthrough, the range handler's window and tests.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition; getUpcomingDates keeps its own `count * 7` over-fetch instead of using getShiftWindowDays, leaving one window-size decision outside the new helper.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay/getDateWithSkippedNonWorkingDays behind applyWeekendRule in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and budget/schedule-template.ts
